newsitem.title: USA: Energen unit to buy Amoco's Black Warrior assets. [CORRECTED 15:44 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Energen unit to buy Amoco's Black Warrior assets. [CORRECTED 15:44 GMT]

text.p: Energen Corp said its unit, Taurus Exploration Inc, has reached a definitive agreement to buy Amoco Corp's Black Warrior Basin coalbed methane properties for $72 million.
(Corrects name of unit from Taurau Exploration Inc)
The properties are located on about 100,000 acres in Jefferson County, Ala., and include more than 260 producing wells, Energen said.
The properties have estimated net proved reserves of 90 billion cubic feet, it said.
Under a 1988 agreement with Amoco, Taurus operated 170 of the wells. It will now operate all of the wells, Energen said.

Upon closing of the acquisition, Taurus will have invested about $270 illion in producing properties, $10 million in associated development and $42 million in exploration and related activities, Energy said.
